adaptations: Written 365 x165 ft main hall becomes112 x50 m. Overall siting and32 m chord-arcades are composition choices; Conkey 1100 ft overall is not treated as a calibrated envelope.
The 16-sided wings use 8 m native edges, adapting the 133.5/135 ft statements; the aquarium layout is interpreted from text, not an inspected aquarium construction plan.

Upper gallery heights, roof pitches, turret heights and cross-connections are game adaptations on 2.12 m levels. The L8 external drum balcony remains decorative without an accepted upper access route.
The original installation identifiers are exhibit positions, not wall bays or surveyed structural spacing.
plan.anchor: Ground at centre of the front entry; +X toward aquarium, +Z to rear. This is a local art anchor, not a surveyed fair-site placement.

integration: Native art candidate only; no production map, fixed catalogue/provider registration, simulation, collision or navigation adapter. Section IDs skip construction of unrequested art sections; no claim to the separate nearby-map streaming contract.
limits: Main/gallery and angling diagrams are inspected. Aquarium tanks/rock basin follow contemporary text but exact layout and hidden service systems are interpreted.
Main gallery L3 is reached by four adapted flights; high drum balcony and turret roofs are decorative, without accepted upper access.
Portal state poses art only. Native leaf bodies retain 1 x1.65 x.12 m; explicit top extensions make 2.72 m high paired doors.
Arcade siting, pitches, upper heights, exhibit positions and warm palette are adaptations; no complete as-built reconstruction.
